mapper.select: INSERT INTO accounting_request_queue ( status_id, type_id, reference, original_reference, account_id, account_type_id, created_ts, psp_event_queue_id, idempotency_key, merchant_reference, success, amount, currency_id, psp_reference ) VALUES ( (SELECT accounting_request_status_type_id FROM accounting_request_status_type WHERE accounting_request_status_type_code = 'RECEIVED'), #{typeId}, #{reference}, #{originalReference}, #{accountId}, (SELECT account_type_id FROM account_type WHERE code = 'MERCHANT'), now(), #{pspEventQueueId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{merchantReference}, #{success}, #{amount}, #{currencyId}, #{pspReference} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING queue_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounting_request_queue_line (queue_id, order_line_reference, amount) VALUES (#{queueId}, #{orderLineReference}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT q.queue_id, q.created_ts, q.done_ts, q.done, q.status_id, q.result_id, q.type_id, q.reference, q.original_reference, q.account_id, q.psp_event_queue_id, q.idempotency_key, q.merchant_reference, q.success, q.amount, q.currency_id, q.psp_reference, t.transaction_id FROM accounting_request_queue q LEFT JOIN transaction t ON t.reference = q.original_reference WHERE q.queue_id = #{queueId}
SELECT queue_id, order_line_reference, amount FROM accounting_request_queue_line WHERE queue_id = #{queueId} ORDER BY order_line_reference

SELECT q.queue_id, q.created_ts, q.done_ts, q.done, q.status_id, q.result_id, q.type_id, q.reference, q.original_reference, q.account_id, q.psp_event_queue_id, q.idempotency_key, q.merchant_reference, q.success, q.amount, q.currency_id, q.psp_reference, t.transaction_id FROM accounting_request_queue q LEFT JOIN transaction t ON t.reference = q.original_reference WHERE NOT q.done AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM accounting_request_queue older WHERE older.original_reference = q.original_reference AND NOT older.done AND (older.created_ts, older.queue_id) < (q.created_ts, q.queue_id) ) AND ( t.transaction_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_lock live_lock WHERE live_lock.transaction_id = t.transaction_id AND live_lock.lease_until_ts > now() ) ) ORDER BY q.created_ts, q.queue_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE accounting_request_queue SET status_id = (SELECT accounting_request_status_type_id FROM accounting_request_status_type WHERE accounting_request_status_type_code = 'IN_PROGRESS') WHERE queue_id = #{queueId} AND NOT done
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_lock (transaction_id, queue_id, locked_ts, lease_until_ts) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{queueId}, now(), now() + #{leaseMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond') ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE SET queue_id = EXCLUDED.queue_id, locked_ts = EXCLUDED.locked_ts, lease_until_ts = EXCLUDED.lease_until_ts WHERE payment_lock.lease_until_ts <= EXCLUDED.locked_ts
mapper.update: UPDATE accounting_request_queue SET done = TRUE, done_ts = now(), status_id = (SELECT accounting_request_status_type_id FROM accounting_request_status_type WHERE accounting_request_status_type_code = 'DONE'), result_id = (SELECT accounting_request_result_type_id FROM accounting_request_result_type WHERE accounting_request_result_type_code = 'FAILED') WHERE queue_id = #{queueId} AND NOT done

UPDATE accounting_request_queue SET done = TRUE, done_ts = now(), status_id = (SELECT accounting_request_status_type_id FROM accounting_request_status_type WHERE accounting_request_status_type_code = 'DONE'), result_id = #{resultId} WHERE queue_id = #{queueId} AND NOT done AND status_id = (SELECT accounting_request_status_type_id FROM accounting_request_status_type WHERE accounting_request_status_type_code = 'IN_PROGRESS')
